description: Implementation of the f1u_bearer_impl class handling F1-U bearer operations, including buffer management, PDU handling, and data delivery status reporting in a 3GPP-based radio system.

classes.name: f1u_bearer_impl
classes.description: Class managing F1-U bearer state, buffer, and data delivery status reporting.

methods.name: handle_sdu
methods.description: Handles incoming SDU, buffers or transmits based on configuration.

methods.name: handle_pdu
methods.description: Handles incoming PDU, executes processing in a task executor.

methods.name: handle_pdu_impl
methods.description: Processes received PDU, including delivery, polling, and discard notifications.

methods.name: flush_ul_buffer
methods.description: Flushes the uplink buffer, sending all buffered PDUs.

methods.name: handle_transmit_notification
methods.description: Updates highest transmitted PDCP SN and desired buffer size.

methods.name: handle_delivery_notification
methods.description: Updates highest successfully delivered PDCP SN.

methods.name: handle_delivery_retransmitted_notification
methods.description: Updates highest delivered retransmitted PDCP SN.

methods.name: fill_desired_buffer_size_of_data_radio_bearer
methods.description: Fills desired buffer size info into delivery status.

methods.name: fill_highest_transmitted_pdcp_sn
methods.description: Fills highest transmitted PDCP SN into delivery status.

methods.name: fill_highest_delivered_pdcp_sn
methods.description: Fills highest delivered PDCP SN into delivery status.

methods.name: fill_highest_retransmitted_pdcp_sn
methods.description: Fills highest retransmitted PDCP SN into delivery status.

methods.name: fill_highest_delivered_retransmitted_pdcp_sn
methods.description: Fills highest delivered retransmitted PDCP SN into delivery status.

methods.name: fill_data_delivery_status
methods.description: Populates delivery status fields and restarts notification timer.

methods.name: send_data_delivery_status
methods.description: Sends data delivery status PDU if there are new updates or forced.

methods.name: on_expired_ul_notif_timer
methods.description: Handles expiration of UL notification timer, triggers status report.
